steps.label: GOVERNED PER DOMAIN

steps.label: ACTIVE, NOT STATIC

caption: Creating a new term starts with picking a template — System default has just the basic fields; an organization can define its own richer templates, like this Contoso Sales one.
Microsoft's own callout marks the Status field — a term is Draft until a steward publishes it. Name, Definition, Acronym, Resources, and Data Privacy round out the core fields.

steps.label: DRAFT
steps.sub: being written; not yet visible to business users

steps.label: SUBMIT FOR APPROVAL
steps.sub: a steward or approver reviews it

steps.label: PUBLISHED
steps.sub: visible in the Enterprise Glossary once approved

caption: Microsoft's own callout marks Submit for approval — the step that moves a drafted, defined term into the approval workflow before it reaches business users.
